operator.pairing.gesture.mac: Your Mac will ask for Touch ID or its login password — that's your Mac confirming, not your Radient password.
operator.pairing.gesture.windows: Windows will ask you to allow this — that's Windows confirming, not your Radient password.
operator.pairing.gesture.other: Your computer will ask for its password — that's your computer confirming, not your Radient password.
operator.pairing.prompt.confirm: Local Operator needs your approval to confirm a phone on this computer.
operator.pairing.prompt.remove: Local Operator needs your approval to remove a phone from this computer.
operator.pairing.prompt.setup: Local Operator needs your approval to turn on phone approvals on this computer.
operator.pairing.refusal.confirm_needs_c: This phone did not ask through your Radient account, so this computer can't confirm it by comparing codes. Nothing was approved; type the six digits the phone shows instead.
operator.pairing.refusal.request_changed: This pairing card changed since it was shown. Nothing was approved; review it again.
operator.pairing.refusal.unknown_request: There is no pairing request with that id.
operator.pairing.refusal.withdraw_invali: A withdrawal needs exactly the phone's signature.
operator.pairing.refusal.withdraw_forbid: That signature is not from the phone that asked to pair. Nothing was withdrawn.
operator.pairing.refusal.in_progress: Your computer is already confirming this pairing, so it can't be cancelled from the phone now. Deny it on the computer instead.
operator.pairing.refusal.bad_device_id: That is not a device id this computer issues.
operator.pairing.revoke.unfinished: This phone can no longer approve here or get notifications, but removing it from the operator list did not finish. Run the same command again to finish removing it.
